concepts.description: The SRanger system is a small ground robot that travels in a straight line and turns in place when it detects an obstacle.
The robot carries a single infrared distance sensor mounted facing forward.
The controller is reactive and issues motor commands as advisory events to the differential-drive layer.
The controller receives an IR-driven obstacle event and a system-level endTask event.
The controller includes a Sensor interface and an Actuator interface.
The controller maintains a small set of state variables, notably a clock-reset timestamp for the timed Turning to Moving transition.
A single state machine selects transitions based on the input event, the IR distance, and the elapsed time in the current mode.
The SRanger controller has exactly three operating modes: Moving, Turning, and Final.
The SRanger controller defines four real-valued fixed configuration constants: moveVel, turnVel, obstacleThreshold, and turnDuration.
The SRanger controller receives three input events: obstacle, tick, and endTask.
The SRanger controller emits a single output event, Move, carrying a linear velocity and an angular velocity command.
The Sensor exposes a function distance() that returns the latest IR distance reading.
The distance reading is a real number in metres, non-negative.
The Actuator receives Move events from the controller and stores the latest issued command.
The Actuator stores the latest issued command and exposes the last commanded linear and angular velocity.
The controller maintains a real variable clockResetTime recording when the controller most recently entered the Turning state.

instances.description: SRanger is the small ground robot system specified by the requirement.
obstacle is the IR-driven event that is the controller's only sensor input.
endTask is the system-level shutdown event available to halt the controller.
Sensor is the interface that exposes the latest IR distance reading.
Actuator is the interface that records the last motor command.
Moving is the initial mode in which the robot drives forward at the configured linear velocity.
Turning is the mode in which the robot rotates in place at the configured angular velocity.
Final is the terminal mode entered when the operator issues endTask.
moveVel is the linear velocity command when Moving, default 1.0 m/s.
turnVel is the angular velocity command when Turning, default 2.0 rad/s.
obstacleThreshold is the IR-distance threshold for obstacle detection, default 0.5 metres.
turnDuration is how long the controller remains in Turning before returning to Moving, default 2.0 seconds.
tick is delivered each control cycle by the system framework.
Move is the output event carrying the combined linear and angular velocity command to the differential-drive layer.
distance is the function returning the latest IR distance reading in metres, non-negative.
clockResetTime is the real variable recording when the controller most recently entered the Turning state.
